title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Pinewood Emergency Associates under your health plan for services provided on August 15, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Reason for denial: The provider is not in your plan's network. Your plan does not cover services from out-of-network providers except in an emergency. Reason code: CO-242.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $1,450.28 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $1,450.28.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Ostrander Mutual Health, Appeals Unit, PO Box 27268, Houston, TX 77002. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-6144.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
